Alecto Conveyancing Ltd., a London-based artificial intelligence-native law firm, today announced it raised $20 million in seed funding led by Insight Partners to make the law more accessible to the general public. Firstminute Capital, Blue Lion Global, Andrena Ventures, FJ Labs, Antiportfolio Ventures, the Rigby Group and Mischon de Reya LLP also joined in the […]
